CHECK BURST CS-clutter-spawn-x — extract the added clutter objects from a before/after edit pair and evaluate the pre-registered extraction gate (R-C3-61). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-clutter-spawn-x".

Inputs (read-only): BEFORE /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-canvases/clutter_spawn_canvas.png (bare painted crop, 1536×1024, #00ff00 = void); AFTER /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-spawn/clutter_spawn.png (the same crop with objects added by an image EDIT; the edit may also have re-rendered the whole ground slightly); crop origin in the level canvas /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-clutter-canvases/clutter_spawn.json. Frozen tool /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py may be used for the green key. python glue with PIL/numpy/scipy(/skimage if present); no new tool files.

STEP 1 — GLOBAL DRIFT: per-pixel D = mean |RGB| AFTER−BEFORE. Report median, p75, p90 of D over the whole crop, and the same after a 9×9 median filter of both images (edit re-rendering is high-frequency; objects are not).
STEP 2 — OBJECT CANDIDATES: detect added objects robustly despite drift: compute D on 5×5 box-blurred images, threshold with Otsu on D (report the threshold) AND require a local-structure change (e.g. |gradient magnitude difference| or a colour-shift away from the local ground colour); morphological open/close; connected components ≥ 300 px; merge components whose bounding boxes are within 12 px. For each object: id, bbox in crop px and LEVEL canvas px (add the origin), area, centroid, lowest opaque row (sort/foot line y) and the x-span of its bottom 12 rows (footprint).
STEP 3 — SHADOW vs OBJECT: inside each object's region, split pixels into OBJECT (AFTER differs from BEFORE in hue/structure, not just darker) and SHADOW (AFTER ≈ BEFORE × k with k in 0.35–0.9 and small hue change). Report per object shadow px and whether the split is clean (shadow region contiguous and below/right of the object given upper-left light).
STEP 4 — GATE per object: (g1) ground drift in a 16-px ring outside the object mask: mean D ≤ 6; (g2) the object mask is ONE component and its boundary halo (ring pixels where AFTER differs strongly from BEFORE, D > 25, but classified ground) is ≤ 3 px wide; (g3) shadow separates (STEP 3 clean). Report PASS/FAIL per sub-gate per object as measured facts (you may state the pre-registered thresholds were met or not).
STEP 5 — OUTPUTS: out/objects/<id>_rgba.png (object only, straight alpha from its mask, cropped to bbox + 8 px), out/objects/<id>_shadow.png (shadow as an alpha mask: alpha = (1−k) scaled, black RGB), out/objects.json (all STEP 2–4 numbers), out/diff_heatmap.png (D blurred, 768×512), out/objects_sheet.png (for each object: AFTER crop | extracted object over magenta | extracted object over the BEFORE ground at its position — at 2× zoom, labelled, in rows), out/summary.txt ≤ 15 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-clutter-spawn-x"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL for the burst as a whole.
